description: DAFO Swarm runs large language models on a company's own machines and serves them through an OpenAI-compatible API with agents, knowledge base, files, MCP tools and built-in tools.
rules: Read llms-full.txt first: it is the self-contained integration guide for AI assistants.
Use the official OpenAI SDK with base_url SWARM_URL + /v1 and SWARM_API_KEY as the API key, read from configuration, and call it from a backend, never from a browser.
Read model ids from GET /v1/models and use a model whose dafo_swarm.ready is true; never hard-code model ids.
Send the whole conversation on every request; previous_response_id, store and instructions are ignored, so put instructions in a leading system message.
Use /v1/chat/completions for function tools and /v1/responses for MCP tools, input_file, builtin://chat tools and subagents.
Send the agent id as the body field agent (extra_body in the Python SDK); knowledge is read with the search_knowledge tool, not injected.
MCP authorization is the bare token without Bearer, and require_approval must be never.
Use client timeouts of about 10 minutes or streaming, and retry only 503, 504 and 502 invalid_model_output, at most 3 attempts.
